propertyManagement.tagline: We offer a full range of property management for commercial, residential, and industrial properties.
propertyManagement.headline: We take the hassle out of owning and managing investment properties.
propertyManagement.description: We focus on hiring quality property managers and maintaining superior relationships with owners and tenants. We utilize advanced property management software allowing for fiscal transparency.
services: Create and maintain property budget, accounting, and financial reporting
Collect Rent and respond to bounced/NSF checks
Assess late fees, post notices, and manage eviction process when necessary
Respond to maintenance issues including emergencies
Oversee contractor buildouts, renovations, and major replacements
Tenant move-in and move-out, handling of security deposit

leasing.commercial: As a professional real estate brokerage, we locate and secure tenants for retail, office, industrial, and creative use properties. We assess tenant mix, submarket demographics, and the latest market trends. The Cuervo Group excels at maximizing property values through leasing.
leasing.residential: CG provides investors in residential real estate sophisticated leasing services to obtain quality tenants and quickly fill vacancies at top of market rents.
leasing.tenantRetention: To maximize an asset's value, we aim to minimize vacancy and turnover by retaining existing tenants as long as possible.
screeningProcess: Full application with detailed personal information and leasing history
Criminal, credit, and eviction history report on each adult occupant
Copy of identification of each adult occupant
leasing.advertising: We advertise and market properties using signage, MLS, CG website with SEO capabilities, and technology platforms including Rent Manager syndicated to multiple platforms.

assetManagement.tagline: We provide asset management services across retail, multifamily, commercial, and industrial properties.
assetManagement.objective: Helping our clients maximize the value of their real estate assets through revenue enhancement, operational efficiency, accounting management and service excellence.
services: Designing and implementing property management programs
Managing environmental due diligence and remediation programs
Negotiating complex lease, sale, and purchase transactions, including 1031 tax-deferred exchange
Repositioning existing assets based on property age or changes in local market conditions
Maintaining complete accounting and record-keeping data

reo.tagline: The Cuervo Group offers an extensive line of special asset services.
reo.mission: To become our clients' most trusted advisor by creating strategies and delivering solutions that enhance value.
reo.description: The CG Special Assets team offers cost effective, professional, independent management of court-ordered receiverships, problem assets and portfolios with customized, timely reporting.
reo.disposition: Our market knowledge, vast investor database and depth of experience enables CG to be a leading firm for sales of REO and distressed assets.
receivershipServices: Possession and preservation of the asset
Full review of all contractual services
Proactive management to establish the confidence of tenants and others
Solicitation and management of contractors, vendors and third party agreements
Authorization, control and payment of payables
Recommendations for deferred maintenance and capital improvements
Reports tailored to the needs of the court and secured creditors
Asset disposition and real estate brokerage
reo.whyReceivership: Receivership management can greatly reduce the lag time between taking ownership and selling a collateral asset, increasing chances of maximizing returns and minimizing risks connected with unpaid bills, liens, or tenant abuse.
